info.name: Radiology Manager API
info.description: Postman collection for testing the main endpoints of the Radiology Registry Management System.

header.description: Required authorization header for write operations in the POC setup

request.description: Registers a new radiological device under an organization and optional container. Requires ADMIN role privileges via X-User-Role header.

variable.description: The unique database ID of the organization to retrieve the tree for

request.description: Retrieves the recursive nested location and equipment hierarchy tree for a given organization. This is a public API and requires no role header.
